Hi Elena — thanks again for the call earlier. Quick recap and three asks so we can start the trial kick-off next week:

1) Economic buyer / payor: can you confirm who signs the PO or approves the budget? You mentioned finance may own this — is that Tom Reyes (cc'd) or someone else?

2) Procurement & security route: please confirm the procurement contact and whether we should start with a PO or an MSA. Also let us know if you need SOC 2 evidence or a short security questionnaire (we can push the SOC 2 report and an evidence pack).

3) Timeline & constraints: what is your ideal procurement window? We typically see a 2–3 week turnaround for mid-market POs; if you need faster, we can pre-issue trial agreements on our side while procurement reviews the PO.

I attached a short draft SOW and a one-page trial checklist (no signatures yet) to speed things up. If you prefer, Monica (cc) can run a 20-minute procurement sync with your operations lead.

Next steps: reply with payor name/email, procurement contact, and any mandatory security docs. If it's easier, confirm a 20-minute slot and we will invite the right folks.

Thanks,
